versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the jackyshen-design-workshop-outline skill.
- Generates learner-centered workshop and training outlines using MECE structure, TfBR 4C model, and VAK learning styles.
- Provides clear guidance for requirement gathering, modular structuring, outcome definition, and interactive agenda design.
- Output format includes agenda overview, detailed module flows, and checklist for effective, actionable session planning.
- Designed for requests about workshop outlines, training agendas, course structures, or session planning.
